const c = $json;
const scorePayload = {
  clip_id: c.clip_id,
  asset_url: c.preview_url,
  tenant_id: c.tenant_id,
  run_id: c.run_id,
  job_id: c.job_id,
  schema_version: (c.version && typeof c.version === 'string') ? c.version : null,
  overall_score: c.overall_score,
  decision: c.decision,
  suggested_hook: c.suggested_hook,
  suggested_caption: c.suggested_caption
};

const cardPayload = {
  clip_id: c.clip_id,
  tenant_id: c.tenant_id,
  asset_version: c.asset_version,
  review_stage: c.review_stage,
  job_id: c.job_id,
  ready_file: c.ready_file,
  master_asset: c.master_asset,
  source_title: c.source_title,
  proposed_shorts_title: c.proposed_shorts_title,
  caption: c.suggested_caption,
  hook: c.suggested_hook,
  overall_score: c.overall_score,
  decision: c.decision,
  duration_seconds: c.duration_seconds,
  source_url: c.source_url,
  run_id: c.run_id,
  rights_policy: c.rights_policy,
  publication_enabled: false,
  captions_expected: c.captions_expected === true,
  captions_applied: c.captions_applied === true,
  hook_expected: c.hook_expected === true,
  hook_applied: c.hook_applied === true,
  no_speech: c.no_speech === true,
  transcript_segment_count: c.transcript_segment_count || 0,
  render_version: c.render_version || null
};

return [{ json: { score_payload: scorePayload, card_payload: cardPayload, preview_url: c.preview_url } }];
